text: Row72’s componentwise medians minimize the separated real and imaginary absolute-deviation sums exactly. The q=gcd(N,4) periodic baseline has at most four nonzero Fourier bins with coefficients using only Gaussian-integer quarter rotations. Its finite-word bounds and input-mass error composition are correct under the declared decoder contract. Fresh tests check 400 integer-complex fits against all integer candidate medians and exact means. The source’s particular median-of-medians implementation, original thousands of tests and complete decoder are not certified by this reading. Unit-normalized outputs still need paid normalization or a declared shared algebraic scale.

All15 members were CRC-checked, snapshotted as inert text and matched against their exact hashes; all14 supplied SHA256SUMS entries match. All new proof, research, checkpoint, readme, run instructions, program, tests, audit program and saved logs were inspected in full. AUDIT_LOG.txt and AUDIT_RESULTS.json are byte-identical. The frozen Phase10 reference is byte-identical to the previously fully statically reviewed Phase10 executor, SHA `0402fd91774b631808f3dd51e4cc9faff43593a579dd1109c5e508f8195b835f`; its exact prior review evidence is linked in MEMBER_REVIEW.json. No nested lineage alone was accepted as coverage.

**Traffic correction:** apply_one_pole_green readsx once in the Horner loop and again forN−1 backward equations. Literal input-array reads are2N−1, while Meter.input_reads records onlyN. It also omits theN−1 recurrence reads fromy. In the lazy transform, semantic state_writes excludes zero-list initialization and table reads; integer/index counters are coarse allowances, not a complete Python or word-machine trace. capture/debug storage is separately excluded. These omissions do not change linear-versus-NlogN field asymptotics, but “fully charged” must not be interpreted as an exact all-traffic total.

Area keys are integers in [1,N], so stable counting sort generates sigma in O(N) time and words; comparison sorting is unnecessary. The small support-only checker originally uses Python sorted for readability; the application/normalization checker actually uses counting buckets. q powers are generated consecutively in O(N) operations, not by separately exponentiating every edge. Each phase mask, route, sum, forward Green sweep, and transpose reverse sweep costs O(N); a fixed two-stage application uses four grid solves. There is no claimed cheap synthesis of the unknown middle monomial or successful stage parameters.
